Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Gravitational Pull
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Bend gravity into a distortion field around yourself. Arrows curve. Bullets slow and drift off course. Those standing near you feel something tugging at the air, a wrongness in the way things fall, and realize that the projectiles aimed at them are no longer flying true.
